n3b906ca898.headline: Unemployment in Portugal with the 3rd largest drop in the eurozone in February
n3b906ca898.summary: Portugal's unemployment rate fell significantly in February, marking the third largest drop among eurozone countries.
n3b906ca898.why: Unemployment trends affect economic growth prospects and consumer spending, influencing investment and policy decisions in the eurozone.

na44dac0c79.headline: PSD will ask UTAO to calculate the costs of "forgiving" debt to banks
na44dac0c79.summary: The Portuguese government extended the repayment period of banks' loan to the Resolution Fund before the sale of Novo Banco. The Social Democrats call it a partial debt forgiveness and will ask UTAO to calculate the costs.
na44dac0c79.why: Novo Banco is a Portuguese bank whose sale is handled under state resolution arrangements, so changes to its funding terms affect public finances and bank balance sheets.
